integrity: Full proof, exact finite-state derivation, and a standard-library reproduction program are included. Finite verification is an independent check, not a proof for all heights. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The finite-height statement concerns only 3-adic valuations for standard Fibonomial coefficients on the first 4*3^L rows; higher power residues, arbitrary heights, and other primes are not addressed. Equivalence to unindexed prior work is not excluded.
title: Exact ternary valuation spectra of Fibonomial triangles at fractal scales
